title: Lines stay readable
question: Do text columns stay readable: never squeezed below about 15 characters, never stretched past about 80?

children.name: title
children.text: How we cut our build times in half

children.name: lead
children.text: Last spring a full build of our app took eleven minutes. Here is what we changed, and what it cost us.

children.name: body
children.text: The first thing we measured was where the time went. Most of it was not compiling at all, but waiting on a cache that missed far more often than we thought.

claims.name: body width >= 120
claims.says: Lines of the article are never shorter than about 15 characters (120 px at 8 px a character)

claims.name: body width <= 640
claims.says: Lines of the article are never longer than about 80 characters (640 px at 8 px a character)
